sample.name: Belairfineart
facts: Miami branch is the first U.S. opening of a contemporary art gallery group founded in 2004.
Shows pop art by Mr Brainwash, Alec Monopoly and Banksy, among others.
Part of the Scotch & Soda chain

sample.name: Garden Center Conservatory
facts: The City of Miami Beach created the Garden Center here in 1962, now the Miami Beach Botanical Garden.
Four Miami Beach garden clubs used it for meetings, horticultural education and a glass conservatory.
Local residents formed the Miami Beach Garden Conservancy in 1996 to create a botanical garden.

sample.name: Miami Dade Cultural Center
facts: The complex at 101 West Flagler Street was designed by architect Philip Johnson.
Its raised plaza is framed by the Miami-Dade Public Library and HistoryMiami.

sample.name: Waltman Ortega Fine Art
facts: Opened in 2010 as a partnership of Paris gallerist Olivier Waltman and Miami gallerist Aliona Ortega.
A contemporary art gallery that opened in the Wynwood Art District.
Address: 2300 North Miami Avenue, Unit B, Miami

sample.name: Thomas F. Daly Loggia
facts: Part of the Perez Architecture Center, named for donor Thomas F. Daly.
Run by University of Miami
Address: 1215 Dickenson Drive, Coral Gables

sample.name: Bass Museum of Art
facts: The museum was founded in 1963 and opened to the public on April 7, 1964.
John and Johanna Bass gave the city a collection of more than 500 works including Old Master paintings.
An expansion designed by David Gauld added four galleries and reopened in October 2017.

sample.name: Anthony Liggins Gallery 88
facts: Specializes in works by Atlanta-Miami artist Anthony Liggins.
Held the grand opening of the exhibition Pathways to a Sacred Soul.
Address: 237 20th Street, #C, Miami Beach

sample.name: The Irving Korach Architecture Gallery
facts: Funded by a gift from Marjorie Korach in memory of her husband, architect Irvin Korach.
Run by University of Miami
Address: 1215 Dickenson Drive, Coral Gables

sample.name: Lina Cerrone Gallery
facts: Contemporary fine art gallery co-founded by Lina Cerrone and filmmaker Fredric Lean.
Accepts Bitcoin
Address: 2239 Northwest 2nd Avenue, Miami

sample.name: Lik Gallery
facts: Fine art photography gallery showing the work of photographer Peter Lik on Lincoln Road.
Displays limited-edition landscape and cityscape prints, including backlit images.

sample.name: Oolite Arts
facts: Founded in 1984 by potter Ellie Schneiderman to give visual artists affordable workspace.
Originally ArtCenter/South Florida, it opened in 21 storefronts on a then dilapidated Lincoln Road.
Renamed for oolite, the local sedimentary rock made of shells, coral and other organic material.

sample.name: PARADOX Museum Miami
facts: Held its grand opening on December 15, 2022.
Has over 70 paradox-based interactive exhibits; Miami was the first US city with a Paradox Museum.
Address: 2301 North Miami Avenue, Miami

sample.name: Historic Black Police Precinct Courthouse and Museum
facts: Built in 1950 because segregation barred Miami's Black officers from the main police station.
Designed by Miami architect Walter G. DeGarmo.
Miami hired its first five Black police officers in 1944.

sample.name: Museum of Illusions
facts: Interactive attraction with over 40 3D illusions inspired by movies, cartoons, art and current events.
Address: 536 Lincoln Road, Miami Beach

sample.name: The Screening Room
facts: New media exhibition and project space in the Mitrani Warehouse, directed by Rhonda Mitrani.
Address: 2626 Northwest 2nd Avenue, Miami

sample.name: American Museum of the Cuban Diaspora
facts: The museum, also called The Cuban, was established in 1996 by Dr. Ofelia Tabares and other community leaders.
Its building at 1200 Coral Way had a soft launch in 2016 and a grand opening in 2018.
The museum focuses on Cubans who settled in the United States after the 1959 Cuban Revolution.

sample.name: Alejandra von Hartz Gallery
facts: Contemporary art gallery in the Wynwood area, founded in 2002.
Presents both established and emerging artists, including commissioned and site-specific works.
Address: 2630 Northwest 2nd Avenue, Miami

sample.name: Dina Mitrani Art Gallery
facts: Specializes in contemporary and classic photography by emerging and established photographers.
Housed in the Mitrani family complex, tied to their former women's wholesale apparel business in Wynwood.
Run by Dina Mitrani

sample.name: Gallery 2612
facts: Contemporary art gallery and event venue in the Wynwood Arts District that showcases local artists.
Address: 2612 Northwest 2nd Avenue, Miami
